hold.description: Maintain the current balanced plan; gather more evidence without committing.

pressure.description: Approach and sustain safe pressure to condition the opponent to defend.

break.description: Exploit repeated stationary guarding with a committed guard-breaking attack.

bait.description: Stay just outside range and feint to invite a whiff; avoid committing first.

catch.description: Prepare a delayed tracking strike against the observed repeated dodge direction.

conserve.description: Abandon the commitment, restore distance and conserve stamina.
